usage: 熊貓 (hung4 maau1) is a noun that refers to the animal known as the panda.
When talking about animals, 熊貓 is used to specify this particular species.
You can use 熊貓 in simple sentences describing animals or their actions.
The word 熊貓 does not change form with singular or plural, context will show number.
熊貓 can be used as the subject or object in a sentence.
